mentions.name: VO
mentions.description: VO is a dynamic programming language combining functional, object-oriented, and dynamic features that is 'extendable' from within the language. It offers Unicode symbols, first-class functions assignable to variables, classes implemented as hashes with function members as methods, client-definable pre/infix operators, loop syntax sugar built from loops/break/conditions, and nearly trivial FFI with ncurses and SDL wrapper examples. Planned work includes complete AST control from within the language, further optimizations, and expanded FFI support; it is still under regular development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
VO is my dynamic language, its weird but i like it.

functional, OO and dynamic, its 'extendable' from within the language.
